interventions.description: Relocate the dumpsters to a designated off-street area or a protected on-street parking space to ensure a continuous pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Intersection Improvements
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and curb ramps at the nearby intersection to facilitate safe crossings.

interventions.title: Remove walkway obstructions
interventions.description: Clear the loose metal pipes and any other debris from the sidewalk to ensure a safe, unobstructed path.

interventions.title: Install pedestrian lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety along the blank wall section.

interventions.title: Shared Street (Woonerf) Design
interventions.description: Redesign the narrow street as a shared space with level surfaces and traffic calming to prioritize pedestrians and slow vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearing and Widening
interventions.description: Remove permanent obstructions from the walkway and widen the sidewalk on the right side to provide a continuous accessible path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Signage
interventions.description: Install signage to warn drivers of pedestrian activity, particularly near garage exits and narrow sections.
